title: PAX3::FOXO1-Targeting PROTAC Induces Myogenic Differentiation of Fusion-Positive Rhabdomyosarcoma Cells.
fulltext_rationale: PAX3::FOXO1-targeting PROTAC causes proteasome-dependent endogenous fusion-protein degradation and differentiation of fusion-positive rhabdomyosarcoma cells.

title: PAX3-FOXO1 Contacts BRD4 through Its Acetylated Intrinsically Disordered Region.
fulltext_rationale: PAX3-FOXO1 uses an acetylated intrinsically disordered region to contact BRD4; useful for PAX-family PTM/cofactor targetability, though not direct degradation.

title: IGF2BP2 Maintains Retinal Pigment Epithelium Homeostasis by Stabilizing PAX6 and OTX2.
fulltext_rationale: IGF2BP2 stabilizes PAX6 and OTX2 mRNAs; supports abundance-control logic but is RNA-stability rather than protein turnover.

title: SUMO-specific protease 1 regulates germinal center B cell response through deSUMOylation of PAX5.
fulltext_rationale: SENP1 deSUMOylates PAX5 and maintains PAX5 protein level in germinal center B-cell responses.

title: The ups and downs of Pax6 in neural stem cells.
fulltext_rationale: Commentary summarizes KAT2A acetylation of Pax6, RNF8 ubiquitination, and proteasome-mediated Pax6 degradation.

title: Histone acetyltransferase KAT2A modulates neural stem cell differentiation and proliferation by inducing degradation of the transcription factor PAX6.
fulltext_rationale: KAT2A acetylates PAX6 and facilitates RNF8-mediated ubiquitination and degradation, linking PTM to PAX protein turnover.

title: PHD3 inhibits cell proliferation through hydroxylation of PAX2 at proline 9.
fulltext_rationale: PHD3 hydroxylates PAX2 at proline 9 and functionally suppresses proliferation, showing PAX-family hydroxylation as a regulatory mechanism.

title: Acetylation of PAX7 controls muscle stem cell self-renewal and differentiation potential in mice.
fulltext_rationale: PAX7 acetylation controls muscle stem cell self-renewal and differentiation potential, supporting PAX-family acetylation as a regulatory control point.

title: c-Abl Kinase Is Required for Satellite Cell Function Through Pax7 Regulation.
fulltext_rationale: c-Abl interacts with and phosphorylates Pax7; supports kinase-dependent PAX-family post-translational regulation.

title: 17-DMAG dually inhibits Hsp90 and histone lysine demethylases in alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma.
fulltext_rationale: PAX3-FOXO1 is an Hsp90 client and is destabilized/degraded by geldanamycin and 17-DMAG, suggesting chaperone-dependence as a targetable PAX-family mechanism.

title: PAX6, modified by SUMOylation, plays a protective role in corneal endothelial injury.
fulltext_rationale: PAX6 SUMOylation is experimentally evaluated in corneal endothelial injury; useful comparator evidence for PAX-family SUMO modification.

title: Ck2-Dependent Phosphorylation Is Required to Maintain Pax7 Protein Levels in Proliferating Muscle Progenitors.
fulltext_rationale: CK2 phosphorylation maintains Pax7 protein levels by preventing ubiquitin-proteasome downregulation.

title: Retinoic Acid Induces Ubiquitination-Resistant RIP140/LSD1 Complex to Fine-Tune Pax6 Gene in Neuronal Differentiation.
fulltext_rationale: Readable full text is incidental or describes PAX as an upstream transcriptional/context factor rather than a regulated PAX-family protein mechanism relevant to PAX8 targetability.

title: NEDD4 Regulates PAX7 Levels Promoting Activation of the Differentiation Program in Skeletal Muscle Precursors.
fulltext_rationale: NEDD4 regulates Pax7 levels through ubiquitination and proteasome-sensitive turnover during muscle precursor differentiation.

title: Phosphorylation of PAX3 contributes to melanoma phenotypes by affecting proliferation, invasion, and transformation.
fulltext_rationale: PAX3 phosphorylation contributes to melanoma phenotypes; useful kinase/PTM comparator but less directly tied to degradation.

title: Small molecule inhibition of PAX3-FOXO1 through AKT activation suppresses malignant phenotypes of alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma.
fulltext_rationale: AKT activation phosphorylates PAX3-FOXO1, inhibits transcriptional activity, and promotes proteasomal degradation.

title: Identification of CK2 as the kinase that phosphorylates Pax3 at Ser209 in early myogenic differentiation.
fulltext_rationale: CK2 phosphorylates Pax3 at Ser209 during myogenic differentiation, supporting conserved kinase control of PAX proteins.

title: Pax3 stimulates p53 ubiquitination and degradation independent of transcription.
fulltext_rationale: Readable full text is incidental or describes PAX as an upstream transcriptional/context factor rather than a regulated PAX-family protein mechanism relevant to PAX8 targetability.

title: Identification of serines 201 and 209 as sites of Pax3 phosphorylation and the altered phosphorylation status of Pax3-FOXO1 during early myogenic differentiation.
fulltext_rationale: Identifies Pax3 phosphorylation sites and altered phosphorylation of PAX3-FOXO1, supporting PTM mapping for PAX-family regulation.

title: Role of Pax3 acetylation in the regulation of Hes1 and Neurog2.
fulltext_rationale: Pax3 acetylation regulates neurogenic transcriptional outcomes, adding comparator evidence for PAX-family acetylation control.

title: Taf1 regulates Pax3 protein by monoubiquitination in skeletal muscle progenitors.
fulltext_rationale: Taf1 mediates Pax3 monoubiquitination, enabling proteasomal degradation during skeletal muscle progenitor differentiation.

title: Using protein design algorithms to understand the molecular basis of disease caused by protein-DNA interactions: the Pax6 example.
fulltext_rationale: Protein design analysis predicts many PAX6 paired-domain mutations impair protein stability or DNA-binding energy.

title: Papillorenal syndrome-causing missense mutations in PAX2/Pax2 result in hypomorphic alleles in mouse and human.
fulltext_rationale: PAX2 missense variants produce hypomorphic functional defects relevant to PAX-family localization/activity, though not direct PAX8 regulation.

title: Phosphorylation of serine 205 by the protein kinase CK2 persists on Pax3-FOXO1, but not Pax3, throughout early myogenic differentiation.
fulltext_rationale: CK2 phosphorylation at Pax3/PAX3-FOXO1 sites supports conserved phosphorylation control of PAX-family proteins.

title: The roles of calcium signaling and ERK1/2 phosphorylation in a Pax6+/- mouse model of epithelial wound-healing delay.
fulltext_rationale: Readable full text is incidental or describes PAX as an upstream transcriptional/context factor rather than a regulated PAX-family protein mechanism relevant to PAX8 targetability.
